recognize_zh: 中央分節中性球細胞質中有較粗的紫紅色毒性顆粒，細胞質左上緣有一個小的淡藍色斑點，符合 Döhle 小體；此例的 Döhle 小體較小而細微。
features: Segmented neutrophil with increased, coarse purple cytoplasmic granulation
Small pale blue inclusion at the upper left cytoplasmic periphery (Döhle body)
Three nuclear lobes with condensed chromatin
Background normocytic red cells with occasional crenated forms; platelets present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil with coarse cytoplasmic granulation and a small pale blue inclusion at the periphery of the cytoplasm, consistent with a Döhle body. The background red cells are normocytic with occasional crenated forms, and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with toxic neutrophil changes associated with infection or inflammation.

ddx.vs: MYH9-related inclusions are larger, crisply defined and present in nearly all neutrophils, with macrothrombocytopenia.
Overstaining darkens granules in all cells uniformly without producing discrete pale blue peripheral inclusions.
Chédiak-Higashi neutrophils contain a few giant, irregular gray-pink granules rather than small pale blue ER remnants.
